name: Agents
text: No one can copy your actions, you included.

name: Bait
text: Whenever anyone copies your action, they −1 follower. If it’s a rival, +1 follower.

name: Chronicler
text: Game end: +1 follower per green member.

name: Tribute Band
text: Once per game: do every action a rival you choose has a minion on this round.

name: Doppelganger
text: On Recruit: it becomes a copy of one of your members.

name: Ensemble
text: Whenever you copy your own action, +1 follower.

name: Busker
text: On Recruit: +2 green. Round Start: +2 green.

name: Stunt Double
text: On Recruit: copy the action you just took.

name: Impostor
text: On Recruit: it becomes a copy of a rival’s member.

name: Fan Club
text: On Recruit: +1 green per Green space with a minion.

name: Muse
text: Whenever a rival copies an action, +1 green.

name: Roadie
text: Round Start: +1 green per Green member you have.

name: Understudy
text: On Recruit: copy the action taken the previous turn.

name: Wallflower
text: When you copy an action, double the resources it gives you.

name: Admirer
text: Whenever a rival recruits a member of a color you have none of, +1 of that color.

name: Chefs
text: Worth 2 followers. Once per game: +1 of each color in round I, +2 in round II, +3 in round III.

name: Dyer
text: Round end: +1 yellow per color you hold.

name: Explorer
text: Whenever you take a space outside Yellow, +1 yellow.

name: Go-Between
text: Whenever you recruit a non-yellow member, +1 of its color.

name: Late Bloomers
text: Worth 2 followers. On Recruit: if no rival has fewer followers than you (not counting this card), +1 of each color. Round Start: if no rival has fewer followers than you (not counting this card), +1 of each color.

name: Peddler
text: On Recruit: +1 of each color. Round Start: +1 of each color.

name: Pilgrim
text: On Recruit: +1 of each color.

name: Rainmaker
text: Once per game: raise each of your colors to match your yellow.

name: Weaver
text: Whenever you buy 5 or more followers, +1 of each color.
